articles.title: BD Launches AI-Enabled Medication Dispensing System to the European Market
articles.mainIdea: BD Launches AI-Enabled Medication Dispensing System to the European Market
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BD Launches AI-Enabled Medication Dispensing System to the European Market. BD (Becton, Dickinson and Company) (NYSE: BDX), a leading global medical technology company, today announced the launch of the BD® Pyxis™ Pro Dispensing Solution and BD® Incada™ Connected Care Platform in Europe. This next-generation medication dispensing system combines advanced automation and AI‑driven insights to modernize medication management, reduce disruptions, and improve efficiency while helping clinicians spend more time on patient care.
